metaDescription: SecuEdge protects hotels, resorts and restaurants from guest WiFi attacks, POS malware and social engineering — keeping guests safe and operations running.

hero.headline: Secure Every Stay, Every Table, Every Transaction
hero.sub: One vishing call cost MGM Resorts $80–100M. Caesars paid $15M in ransom to protect 65 million loyalty members. SecuEdge ensures the same playbook never works on your property.

stats.label: MGM Resorts losses from one vishing call
Customer records from Otelier SaaS breach

challenges.title: Guest WiFi Adjacent to Critical Systems
challenges.desc: Hotel guest networks are physically co-located with POS terminals, property management systems and room controls — segmentation failures are endemic across the industry.

challenges.title: POS Malware at Front Desk and Restaurants
challenges.desc: High transaction volume and often outdated terminals make payment systems a primary target for RAM-scraping malware that silently harvests card data.

challenges.title: Property Management System Breaches
challenges.desc: PMS databases hold passport numbers, payment cards, loyalty points, stay history and travel preferences — a complete guest identity profile worth stealing.

challenges.title: IT Helpdesk Social Engineering
challenges.desc: Scattered Spider actors researched MGM employees on LinkedIn, called the IT helpdesk impersonating them, and got credentials reset — no technical exploit needed.

challenges.title: Third-Party SaaS Aggregation Risk
challenges.desc: Hotel management platforms like Otelier serve Marriott, Hilton and Hyatt simultaneously. One SaaS breach exposes guests across every connected brand.

challenges.title: IoT Room Controls on Flat Networks
challenges.desc: Smart locks, HVAC, minibars and entertainment systems are increasingly IP-connected and often share a flat network with back-office systems.

threats.title: Ransomware Across All Property Systems
threats.desc: ALPHV ransomware shut down MGM slot machines, digital room keys, restaurant POS and hotel check-in simultaneously — a single flat network turned one foothold into total paralysis.

threats.title: Loyalty Program Data Theft
threats.desc: Caesars Entertainment had its 6-terabyte loyalty database — containing SSNs and driver's licences for 65 million members — exfiltrated by attackers who entered through a vendor.

threats.title: Supply Chain SaaS Compromise
threats.desc: When Otelier (used by Marriott, Hilton and Hyatt) was breached, 437,000 customer records were exposed in an attack the individual hotels had no visibility into.

threats.title: Guest WiFi as Network Pivot
threats.desc: Without proper isolation, a guest or attacker on the WiFi network can probe POS terminals, PMS servers and staff workstations on the same physical infrastructure.

threats.title: Credential Reset Fraud
threats.desc: Social engineering of outsourced IT helpdesks is the Scattered Spider playbook — and hospitality's high staff turnover and less security-trained support teams make it highly effective.

approach.title: VPN with MFA Stops Credential Theft
approach.desc: Even after a successful helpdesk credential reset, VPN access requires a second factor the social engineer does not have. This single control stops the entire MGM and Caesars attack chain.

approach.title: Captive Portal Isolates Guest Traffic
approach.desc: SecuEdge's captive portal authenticates every guest device and places it in a VLAN with no route to PMS, POS or staff systems — isolating the broadest attack surface in any hotel.

approach.title: VLAN Segmentation Across Every Zone
approach.desc: Guest, staff, POS, PMS and IoT room controls sit on separate VLANs with explicit allow rules between them. Ransomware hitting one zone cannot propagate to the rest.

approach.title: Bandwidth Monitoring Catches Mass Exfiltration
approach.desc: A 6-terabyte loyalty database download is an enormous anomaly. SecuEdge's traffic monitoring flags bulk outbound transfers against a normal baseline within minutes.

capabilities.title: Captive Portal & Guest WiFi Management
capabilities.desc: Authenticate guests, enforce acceptable-use policies, and completely isolate guest traffic from PMS, POS and back-office systems — with branded splash pages and per-session bandwidth control.

capabilities.title: VPN with Multi-Factor Authentication
capabilities.desc: Require certificate-based or TOTP second factor before any remote session reaches hotel management systems — eliminating the credential-reset attack that took down MGM Resorts.

capabilities.title: Firewall Network Segmentation
capabilities.desc: Place guest WiFi, POS, PMS, staff workstations and IoT room controls on separate VLANs with firewall rules controlling exactly which systems can speak to which others.

capabilities.title: DNS & Content Category Blocking
capabilities.desc: Block known ransomware C2 domains, phishing pages and malware distribution sites across all networks — including guest WiFi where acceptable-use enforcement is also applied.

capabilities.title: Bandwidth Management & Anomaly Detection
capabilities.desc: Prioritise POS transaction traffic over guest streaming, and alert on bulk outbound data transfers that indicate credential or loyalty database exfiltration in progress.

capabilities.title: Network Monitoring & Threat Logs
capabilities.desc: Continuous logging of east-west and north-south traffic provides the visibility to detect lateral movement and pre-ransomware reconnaissance before systems are encrypted.

process.title: Network Audit & Zone Mapping
process.desc: Inventory every connected system — PMS, POS, IoT room controls, staff workstations, guest WiFi — and map which zones need which access rules.

process.title: Segmented Deployment
process.desc: Deploy VLANs for each zone, configure captive portal for guest WiFi, enforce VPN with MFA for remote and vendor access, and enable DNS filtering across all networks.

process.title: Continuous Monitoring & Policy Tuning
process.desc: Review traffic logs, update DNS block lists, and refine firewall rules as the property grows — with WAN failover ensuring no security gap during ISP outages.

faqs.q: How does SecuEdge stop attacks like the MGM Resorts incident?
faqs.a: Scattered Spider's attack chain required two things: a successful credential reset via vishing, then network access to spread ransomware. SecuEdge breaks both links. VPN with MFA means a reset password alone cannot open a session. VLAN segmentation means even a compromised account cannot reach casino floor systems from the HR network.

faqs.q: Can SecuEdge protect guest WiFi while keeping it easy for guests to connect?
faqs.a: Yes. SecuEdge's captive portal provides a branded splash page — guests connect just like any hotel WiFi — but their traffic is placed in an isolated VLAN with no route to back-office systems. The guest experience is seamless; the security boundary is hard.

faqs.q: We use a cloud property management platform. Does SecuEdge help?
faqs.a: SecuEdge controls the network path between your property and third-party platforms. Firewall rules restrict which internal systems can reach PMS cloud APIs, and egress filtering flags unusual bulk data transfers — providing a detection layer even when the SaaS vendor's own security is compromised.

faqs.q: How does SecuEdge handle PCI DSS requirements for our POS systems?
faqs.a: SecuEdge places POS terminals in a dedicated VLAN with whitelist-only outbound rules permitting connections only to authorised payment processor IPs. Traffic logging provides the audit trail PCI DSS requires, and DNS filtering blocks malware C2 domains from reaching terminals.

cta.headline: Protect Every Guest, Every Transaction
cta.sub: Let SecuEdge segment your property network, isolate guest WiFi and enforce MFA — so a single vishing call or vendor breach never shuts down your operations.
